description: Erection of a two storey rear extension and a front porch to the house, and insertion of four rooflights into the roof
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1003_16NC_X000; 1003_16NC_X001; 1003_16NC_X002; 1003_16NC_X003; 1003_16NC_D101; 1003_16NC_D102; 1003_16NC_D103 Rev D; 1003_16NC_D104 Rev D; 1003_16NC_D105 Rev D; 1003_16NC_D106 Rev D; 1003_16NC_D107 Rev B; 1003_16NC_D108 Rev B. Received 27/09/2019. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 16 Naseby Close and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
